title.narrative: Integrated and Sustainable Urban Regeneration Milan Rio ¿ REMIRIO

description.narrative: Strengthening and consolidating the partnership between Rio de Janeiro and Milan local authorities through the definition and implementation of sustainable integrated urban regeneration policies and actions, improving urban governance, social inclusiveness, urban resilience and fight climate change in accordance with 2030 Agenda.Urban Governance of the city of Rio strengthened through the capacity building of Rio's authorities for the implementation of a Sustainable, Adaptable, Replicable and Integrated Urban Regeneration methodology for vulnerable areas within consolidated urban fabric, that engages different sectors of the local government in order to offer better services to the citizens and contributing to Rio de Janeiro¿s digital solutions for urban governance.
